plans.idea: Classic leaderboard read: brand sign-in at left, product and headline as one tight cluster just after it, and a CTA anchored on the right, with the text box sized to remove the engine's dead middle gap.
Product-led story read left to right: bottle, Glow and its line, then the Shop Now button right next to the copy, with the logo at the far right as a brand sign-off.
Symmetric frame: logo and CTA hold the two ends, and the bottle with the Glow headline sit as one centred focal group on the canvas's middle axis.
